LanguageData.RL_AscensionJoy_Mind.stages.0.label: Ascension Joy · Mind Over Matter
LanguageData.RL_AscensionJoy_Mind.stages.0.descriptio: Only a fraction of the potential contained within our minds has been unlocked. The latent psionic abilities of our species are only now beginning to manifest in certain individuals.
LanguageData.RL_AscensionJoy_Mech.stages.0.label: Ascension Joy · Synthetic Evolution
LanguageData.RL_AscensionJoy_Mech.stages.0.descriptio: It is time to abandon the flawed organic vessels that imprison our minds. By transferring our neural patterns into synthetic bodies, we will achieve a higher state of being.
LanguageData.RL_AscensionJoy_Body.stages.0.label: Ascension Joy · Cybernetic Ascension
LanguageData.RL_AscensionJoy_Body.stages.0.descriptio: The limits and constraints imposed on us by our feeble organic bodies are simply unacceptable. To reach our full potential, we must turn to cybernetic implants.
LanguageData.RL_AscensionJoy_Gene.stages.0.label: Ascension Joy · Genetic Ascension
LanguageData.RL_AscensionJoy_Gene.stages.0.descriptio: To leave our genetic destiny in the hands of nature is an inefficient and excruciatingly slow process. Why not jump-start the future of our species?
